REQ Snnn = REQ-GTI-SYS-nnn · SWnnn / HWnnn = REQ-GTI-SW-nnn / REQ-GTI-HW-nnn. Amber = optional by feature (appliesWhen); red = safety path. Regulatory values are unverified review inputs.
